name: The feedtank and feedwater conditioning
notes: Page read 2026-11-24 with WebFetch during the gas-fired boiler sweep. Traditional feedtank capacity is one hour of steaming at maximum evaporation; vent DN80 on a 2,000 L tank to DN250 on 30,000 L; about 1% less fuel per 6 C rise in feedtank temperature; sodium sulphite dosing 8 ppm per ppm oxygen plus 4 ppm reserve; condensate return above about 80% risks feedpump cavitation. Evidence: https://spiraxsarco.com/learn-about-steam/the-boiler-house/the-feedtank-and-feedwater-conditioning?sc_lang=en-GB
